title: "V0004 invalid_character"
description: "The source contains a character that cannot start any token."
---

An error from the `lex` phase. `sakura explain V0004` prints this explanation offline.

The source contains a character that cannot start any token. Remove it, or put it inside a string.

Wrong:

```sakura
fn price() -> Int { 1 $ 2 }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
fn price() -> Int { 1 + 2 }
```
